notes.title: Special Discount 80% for Our New VR Game "Wand Wars VR"!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! Our new VR game "Wand Wars VR" is available now, here comes the biggest discount ever 80% for Children of Colossus!

If you are interested in a roguelike magic action VR game, please have a look at our Wand Wars VR here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/765730/Wand_Wars_VR/

notes.title: Oculus Support and New Discount Is Coming!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! Our game supports Oculus Rift and Touch now, and the new discount of 40% is coming! Hope you enjoy our experimental VR action game.

And here comes our really mature VR magic & action game - 8 to 10 hours of game time, hope you all will like it!
